title: Sporting events for one Europe/London day
description: Field whitelist. Readers compute live state with the manifest's compatibility.live_state_rule (1.6: status_observed_at, expected_end_utc; older feeds: start/end and taxonomy typical_minutes); broadcasts appear only when broadcast_verified is true. events:<date> carries tier 'core'; the optional events_extra:<date> assets use this schema for tier 'extra'.

participant_crests.description: Optional (capability team_crests, SportsLiveInfo 0.3.25+). Index-aligned with participants. Each entry is a crest REFERENCE {src, ref} or null; never an image. Build the URL from manifest rights.crests.sources[src].url_template; show a monogram when null, when the source is disabled or when monogram_only is true.

start_precision.description: scheduled | provisional | not_before | estimated | time_tbc | date_only | (unknown: time_tbc)

status_normalized.description: scheduled | live | finished | postponed | cancelled | unknown; 'live' is trusted only under compatibility.live_state_rule

status_observed_at.description: 1.6+, always present: when status_normalized was last observed from the source(s)

expected_end_utc.description: 1.6+: start_utc + the typical duration for the sport/event type (or the source's own end); absent for date_only events

live_until_utc.description: 0.3.24+: present when status_normalized is live: show LIVE only while start_utc <= now < live_until_utc (computed by SportsLiveInfo from the observation and the expected end)

tier.description: 1.6+: core events are in events:<date> and today; extra events in events_extra:<date>

broadcast_links.description: Optional (1.3+). Guide-listed, unverified event->channel links: canonical ids only, no guide text or times. Never makes broadcast_verified true. 1.6: status guide_corroborated when a strict match at the same slot on a curated registry channel is listed by two or more independent guide families (verification independent_guides_v1).

binds.description: 0.3.24+: true when this link may name the channel showing the event (Sports Today, on now); false = 'may be on' only. Readers use it as published

rank.description: 0.3.24+: links are published best first; rank 1 is the best. Readers keep this order

origin.description: Private feed only: live sport listed in the guides with no event-source fixture
